messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high error rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 — paging oncall @Sam at 02:15 UTC. Incident ID INC-2024-4123
Sam: I'm on it. seeing 502 spikes from runtime pods, guessing model load spike or OOM. taking page.
Maya: Adding context — customer A reported timeouts as well. putting the incident channel up: #inc-4123-live.
Leon: Reassigning traffic to fallbacks now: route policy -> 'fallback-small' in 60s. Will post ETA.
Sam: Confirmed failover triggered, 40% of requests now on fallback. latency improving to ~220ms but errors still at ~4%.
Jess (ops_lead): Good. Sam, can you capture a short timeline for the RCA? I'll run initial customer comms.
Sam: Timeline note: 02:12 error rate starts, 02:15 pager -> Sam, 02:16 reroute to fallback, 02:22 autoscaler restarted 3 pods, 02:31 errors reduced below threshold.
Komal: Can someone grab controller logs around 02:10-02:25 and the model-serving metrics? I'll look for KV-cache misses and memory spikes.
Sam: Pasted quick logs: ```
[02:14:58] runtime: allocate failed: out of memory
[02:15:10] request_id=abc123 model_load_attempt=1 status=OOM
[02:15:34] scaler: restarting pod/gpu-12
```
Henry: Noted. That OOM looks suspicious — maybe quantized variant fallback didn't have correct memory limits. Opening a short runbook check: runbook/refill-cache -> step 3 says set env MAX_KV_CACHE=4GB.
Maya: I'll start the postincident doc here: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2024-4123 (please edit and avoid changing the header until we have a single owner). Who wants RCA draft owner?
Sam: I'll draft the timeline and mitigation section. Komal can take contributing factors and logs. Henry take remediation proposal (config + monitoring). Maya to coordinate customer impact summary and comms draft. Jess to triage action items and ensure prioritization.
Jess (ops_lead): Assigning owners and due dates: Sam (timeline + mitigation) due EOD today, Komal (contrib factors + logs) due tomorrow 11:00, Henry (remediation + infra fix PR) due in 3 days, Maya (customer-impact + comms) due today 16:00. I'll follow up in #oncall-handoff.
Komal: Quick ask — need the exact model version and quantization profile used on the failing pods. Sam can you paste from the deploy metadata?
Sam: Deploy metadata: model-id: redwood/llamaX-v2, quant: int8qv2, container: rwd-infer:3.1.2, mem-limit: 12Gi.
Henry: Proposed remediation: increase mem-limit to 20Gi for quant int8qv2 + add autoscaler threshold at 65% memory and alert at 75% to paging. Will open PR and link to doc.
Maya: For customer impact: initial Affected customers: A, B (partial degraded), C (timeouts). Comms draft: short outage note + apology + ETA for fix rollout. CommsBot, please queue a customer-notify draft for legal review.
CommsBot: Draft queued at https://comm.drafts/INC-2024-4123 — added reviewers @legal @support.
Jess (ops_lead): Action item tracker in doc: Sam: timeline (in progress), Komal: logs (in progress), Henry: infra PR (todo), Maya: comms (in progress), Ops: postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Is that ok for everyone? :thumbsup:
Sam: OK from me. I'll ping for peer review once timeline is up.
Komal: I'll attach the log bundle and perf graphs in the doc when ready.
Henry: I'll include the small experiment results for mem-limit bump before opening PR. If green, can fast-track to staging.
Maya: Also flagging: follow-up action to add a regression test covering large-batch model loads. Add to backlog with P2 priority.
Sam: Quick note for RCA: probable root cause = memory under-provisioning for quantized model variant + autoscaler thresholds not aggressive enough to catch rapid load spikes. Contributing factors: unclear mem limit defaults, missing alert on mem watermark, rollout of int8qv2 image w/out perf test.
Jess (ops_lead): Perfect. Once Sam posts draft, I'll create a review thread for peer review and sign-off. We aim for final sign-off within 72 hours and follow-up scheduled remediation in the sprint after next.
Sam: Draft link: https://docs.internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2024-4123#timeline — please comment inline.
Maya: tagging reviewers: @Henry @Komal @Jess (ops_lead) — can you do a quick pass before 10:00 UTC tomorrow?
Henry: I'll review and add infra-specific notes.
Komal: Will do.
Jess (ops_lead): Thanks team. I'll set a reminder for the 10:00 postmortem meeting and post the calendar invite. Closing live mitigation thread — leave any follow-ups in the doc. :white_check_mark:
